'''Reiner Zetsche''' finished 8th at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec-sun">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Sunday semi-final results], Decipher (7 December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427191534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Internet Archive]</ref> He won the [[1997 Cologne Open]], a qualifier for that event.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Decipher listed Reiner Zetsche as 21 years old and said a biography was unavailable.<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/zetsche.html Reiner Zetsche], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428140338/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/zetsche.html Internet Archive]</ref>
